These securities are PSUs. Each PSU represents a contingent right to receive one share of Class A common stock. The PSUs are eligible to vest based on the Company's market capitalization over a performance period beginning on the Grant Date and ending on October 30, 2032, subject to the Reporting Person continuing to be a service provider through each such date. || Certain of these securities are represented by RSUs and performance-based restricted stock units ("PSUs").
